 Watch: Cignetti joins McAfee, Rece Davis talks IU football with media
 By TDH Staff October 30, 2026 
 IU Football 
 6 Comments 
 Share 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Pinterest 
 Email 
 Watch as IU football coach Curt Cignetti sat down with Pat McAfee Friday afternoon.  Further below you can see a media Q&A with ESPN college football analyst Rece Davis to talk about the Hoosiers.
 Both McAfee and Davis will lead ESPN’s College GameDay on Saturday as the show airs live from the IU campus beginning at 9 a.m. ET.  No. 4 Indiana (7-1) and Minnesota kick at 3:30 p.m. ET Saturday at Memorial Stadium in Bloomington (CBS).
 Videos by The Pat McAfee Show, and Jack Rizzo for TDH, respectively.
